budget_calibration.note: Budgets are declared in provider tokens and converted with a measured ratio.

native_summary_contract.trigger: pre-hook payload above the soft budget minus fixed reserve
native_summary_contract.retention: most recent messages up to the target budget, verbatim
native_summary_contract.pinned: leading system/task statement always kept verbatim
native_summary_contract.acceptance: summary accepted only when the payload shrinks
native_summary_contract.failure_policy: provider error leaves the messages untouched
native_summary_contract.accounting: summary request charged to the same global request budget
native_summary_contract.adapter_state: the Context-Pruner adapter stays detached in this arm
native_summary_contract.regrowth_rule: an already-summarised payload is not summarised again until it grows 25%

plugin_trigger_contract.symmetric_budget: the adapter rewrites the model view only above the soft budget
plugin_trigger_contract.always: v1 behaviour: the adapter serves the pruned view on every model call
plugin_trigger_contract.why: comparing arms that obey different trigger conditions would mix when to compress with what to compress

synthetic_disclosure: Only synthetic conversations, identifiers, tool arguments, and synthetic tool results are sent. No workspace files or source code are read.
